title: Locations and Systems
summary: Covers the concept of a FLOWCAL system (with 'enterprise' as the default) and how locations are set up so that one or more meters can be added to them.

sections.heading: Systems and Enterprise
sections.body: FLOWCAL has a default system called enterprise. A customer may set up additional systems - for example, a separate system using a different set of units - alongside the default enterprise system.
key_points: The default FLOWCAL system is called enterprise.
Additional systems can be configured, such as one using a different unit set, alongside enterprise.

sections.heading: Adding Meters to a Location
sections.body: A location represents a physical or logical grouping in FLOWCAL, and it is possible for multiple meters to belong to the same location. Meters are added to a location as part of setting it up.
key_points: A single location can contain multiple meters.
Meters are attached to a location during location setup.

faqs.question: What is the name of FLOWCAL's default system?
faqs.explanation: The Systems and Enterprise section states FLOWCAL's default system is called enterprise.

faqs.question: Can multiple meters belong to the same FLOWCAL location?
options: No, only one meter per location is allowed
Yes, a single location can contain multiple meters
Only if they are the same meter type
faqs.explanation: The Adding Meters to a Location section confirms a single location can contain multiple meters.
